The [[Quadex/Legends|Quadex]] '''IGt engine''' was a powerful engine used on the [[StarViper-class attack platform/Legends|StarViper]] prototype, ''[[Virago]]''. Mounted in the fighter's aft, its IGt engines provided forward thrust while its wingtip [[N2-f microthruster]]s were used for maneuvering.<ref name="EGVV" />
